mentions.author: freshhawk
mentions.story: We're creating a culture of distraction
mentions.why: Short film on phone distraction with a great surreal creepy vibe.
mentions.quote: Have you seen the short film called "I Forgot my Phone" ( [VIDEO] )? It deals with exactly this subject and has a great surreal creepy vibe. Made me think about how many times I've been that blinking person who didn't hear their food order, which I dislike but keep doing.

mentions.author: ohwp
mentions.why: Viral short film about forgetting your phone; commenter says it rings true.
mentions.quote: I own a cell phone but never use it for the same reasons as you. Never missed it, never will. This month a video went viral about the subject: [VIDEO] (I Forgot My Phone). So true.
